statBlock.name: Beholder Zombie
statBlock.description: A reanimated beholder still floats and fires magical rays. Spellcasting beholders sometimes raise these corpses from rivals they have defeated.

sections.Languages: Understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage drops the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken. Skip the save for Radiant damage or damage from a Critical Hit. On a success, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Eye Rays twice.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose a visible target within 120 ft. and roll 1d4 for the ray. Reroll any ray already used this turn.
1. Paralyzing Ray. DC 14 Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect and succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
2. Fear Ray. DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
3. Enervation Ray. DC 14 Constitution save. Failure inflicts 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn. It can't regain HP while Poisoned this way. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
4. Disintegration Ray. DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure inflicts 27 (5d10) Force damage and turns a 10-ft. Cube of a targeted nonmagical object or magical force creation to dust. Success halves the damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray disintegrates on either result.

statBlock.name: Bone Naga
statBlock.description: Rituals can raise a dead naga as a skeletal guard. It keeps some of its living magic, but undeath leaves gaps in its memory. A few pursue the goals they had in life.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The naga can use Serpentine Gaze in place of either or both attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit inflicts 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
Serpentine Gaze. A visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure, it takes 13 (3d6 + 3) Psychic damage and is Charmed until the start of the naga's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 13). No Material components are needed.
At will. Mage Hand, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Command, Detect Thoughts, Lightning Bolt.

statBlock.name: Crawling Claw
statBlock.description: An animated severed hand stalks the living. Some single out particular victims, and a rare few act while the rest of their former body still lives.

sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 2 Necrotic damage.

statBlock.name: Minotaur Skeleton
statBlock.description: This hulking skeleton can come from a minotaur or be assembled from several creatures. It bowls prey over with its horns.

sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved at least 20 ft. directly toward it immediately before hitting, add 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and knock it Prone.
Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Revenant
statBlock.description: A revenant reanimates its former body to hunt its killer. If the body is destroyed, it can claim another corpse on the same plane.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. The revenant restores 10 HP at the start of each of its turns. Fire or Radiant damage stops that healing at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Undead Restoration. The revenant returns 24 hours after it dies unless someone casts Dispel Evil and Good on its corpse. It animates a different Humanoid corpse elsewhere on the same plane. Its appearance changes, and it returns at full HP using this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Vengeful Glare and make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.
Vengeful Glare. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, it is Frightened. A target cursed by Vow of Revenge is also Paralyzed while this effect lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.
sections.Bonus actions: Vow of Revenge (1/day). Curse a visible creature within 30 ft. The revenant knows its distance and direction, even across planes. This curse ends when the revenant uses Vow of Revenge on a different creature.

statBlock.name: Warhorse Skeleton
statBlock.description: An undead steed still bears scraps of its old barding. It may carry the remains of its former rider.

sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved at least 20 ft. directly toward it immediately before hitting, the target falls Prone.

statBlock.name: Zombie
statBlock.description: An animated humanoid corpse often guards a site or serves the magic-user who raised it.

sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage drops the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken. Skip the save for Radiant damage or damage from a Critical Hit. On a success, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.
